title: Huawei Enjoy 100 Pro Max and Enjoy 100 Pro are official
description: Huawei has launched the Enjoy 100 Pro and Enjoy 100 Pro Max in China with Kirin 8000-series chipsets and HarmonyOS 7.0. Both phones are now available to purchase in the country and come in four color options each. The Huawei Enjoy 100 Pro features a 6.7-inch OLED display with Full-HD+ resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the Kirin 8020A chipset and offers up to 512GB of internal storage. For optics, it gets a square-shaped rear camera module housing a 50MP RYYB sensor with an f/1.8 aperture. On the front, it features a 32MP camera for selfies and video calls. The...

title: Samsung launches the Galaxy Buds On clip-on earbuds in the US, here's the price
description: At the beginning of this month, Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Buds On, its first pair of clip-on earbuds. Today, the company has also announced them for the US market, where they will become available to purchase in early November for $229. Then, Samsung says it will bring them to Europe in early 2027. The Galaxy Buds On are built "for situations that demand awareness" of your environment and "hands-free convenience", Samsung says. The company used AI-assisted optimizations and physics simulations to refine their design for "a diverse range of ear shapes", drawing on more than 119 million...

title: Huawei Pura 90 Plus launched with Kirin 9025 and 1-inch type main sensor with variable aperture
description: Huawei’s Pura 90 series got a new member in China today with the Pura 90 Plus. It slots in between the Pura 90 and Pura 90 Pro, featuring a Kirin 9025 chipset and a 1-inch type sensor with an f/1.4-4.0 variable aperture. The 50MP main sensor is joined by a 48MP telephoto lens with up to 4x optical zoom. The tele lens also doubles as a macro shooter and features an f/2.1 aperture. The third module on the back is a 13mm equivalent 40MP ultrawide lens. Pura 90 Plus brings a mix of the Pura 80 Pro’s rounded frame with the more expressive colorways seen on the rest of the Pura 90...

title: vivo X500 unboxing and hands-on
description: The vivo X500 series just went international, but the X500 will see narrower availability than the two Pro models. For now we know the vanilla model is available in Southeast Asia, but will skip on Europe. The series is expected to launch in India in November and we'll then get a confirmation of which models will be available there. The global vivo X500 series Despite being the non-Pro model in the series, the vivo X500 ships in a fully-featured retail package. It packs a case, a USB-A to USB-C cable, and a 90W charger. Unboxing the vivo X500 The case fits and feels...

title: Infinix Note 70 Pro visits Geekbench with a mysterious Snapdragon chipset
description: Earlier this month, the Infinix Note 70 Pro showed up in a certification database, and a previous DevCheck entry for its X6766 model number pointed to it using the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset. Today, the same model number has appeared on Geekbench, and things aren't quite that simple anymore. The benchmark listing reveals a Qualcomm SM7635 chipset with one CPU core clocked at 2.96GHz, three at 2.71GHz, and four at 2.02GHz, paired with an Adreno 810 GPU. The phone had 8GB of RAM and ran Android 17, managing 1,145 points in the single-core test and 3,523 in the multi-core one. SM7635...

title: Sony announces new LYTIA 720 50MP 1/1.56-inch sensor for mobile
description: Sony has announced the LYTIA 720, a new 50MP stacked CMOS image sensor designed for mobile devices. The Sony LYTIA 720 measures 1/1.56-inches and features a 1.0μm pixel size. It uses Sony’s proprietary Ultra High Conversion Gain (UHCG) circuit technology, which is claimed to improve low-light performance by reducing random noise by up to 50% compared to the LYTIA 700. The new sensor also combines UHCG technology with Hybrid Frame-HDR (HF-HDR) to achieve a dynamic range of 100dB. The sensor also supports 4K 60 fps HDR video recording using single-frame HDR...

title: Moto G47 Power arrives with a 7,000 mAh battery and faster charging
description: Motorola has just made the Moto G47 Power official in Europe. It's not a successor to the Moto G47 that launched back in April, but a new member of that family, and it lives up to its name by going from a 5,200 mAh battery to a 7,000 mAh one. That matches what an EPREL listing revealed earlier this month, and the phone looks just like the leaked renders. Charging has also gone from 20W to 30W, and there's 6W wired reverse charging so you can top up other devices. Motorola says the G47 Power can last up to 78 hours on a single charge. All of that comes at a cost, though - the new phone...

title: Samsung Galaxy A08 launched in India with a 6,000mAh battery
description: Samsung has brought its affordable A08 4G phone to India after it went official in select global markets last month. The Galaxy A08 comes with a 6,000mAh battery and a 6.7-inch LCD display with a 90Hz refresh rate. The handset is available for purchase in India via Samsung’s official online store and other offline retail partners. It is priced at INR 18,499 for the sole 4GB/64GB variant. The Galaxy A08 is powered by the MediaTek Helio G99+ chipset, paired with LPDDR5 RAM and UFS 2.2 storage. It gets a microSD card slot for storage expansion with support for up to 2TB. In the...

title: Here's when the vivo X500 series could launch in India
description: After launching in China last month, the vivo X500 series has now debuted in select global markets. A new report has now revealed the expected India launch timeline for the lineup. The vivo X500 series is expected to launch in India towards the end of November, according to the report. The company is also tipped to bring all three models to the country, including the vivo X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max. vivo is also expected to offer the same specifications as the China models. That means the X500 will come with a Dimensity 9600M chipset, while the X500 Pro and Pro Max will use...

title: Redmi K100 debuts with Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset, 10,000mAh battery
description: The Redmi K100 has gone official in China with a massive 10,000mAh battery. It comes with a Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset and a 6.83-inch OLED display. Redmi’s latest K100 series phone is available with a starting price of CNY 3,499 ($525) for the 12GB/256GB variant and is being offered in three color options. The display offers features such as a 165Hz refresh rate, Dolby Vision, and up to 3,200 nits of peak brightness. It also gets an ultrasonic under-display fingerprint scanner. For optics, the Redmi K100 gets a dual-rear camera setup with a 50MP Light Fusion 800 sensor with OIS...

title: vivo X500s screen details leak, testing is already underway
description: Today the vivo X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max went global, over a month after they debuted in China. But the company is apparently already busy with the next member of the family. Now, prolific tipster Digital Chat Station has revealed on Weibo that a "small s iteration" is in testing. According to DCS, the engineering sample has a 6.85-inch flat screen with 2K+ resolution, a 144Hz refresh rate, and equal-width bezels on all four sides. The tipster also says the device follows a "large-screen all-rounder" approach. He didn't name it, but people in the comments have taken it to mean the...

title: Samsung is being fined in South Korea over Galaxy S21 and S22's gaming performance
description: The Korean Fair Trade Commission (FTC) sued Samsung over misleading marketing regarding the Galaxy S21 series, S22 series, and the Galaxy Tab S8 series, and the court decided to fine the tech giant. The reason is a marketing claim that the devices deliver "the ultimate mobile gaming experience," but fails to disclose that the so-called Game Optimizing Service (GOS) throttles the performance. Samsung's GOS automatically throttles the CPU and GPU performance on the said devices when playing demanding games. The throttling "feature" led to freezes, lags and lower graphics quality,...

title: New iPhone 18e leak covers its chip, cameras, and display
description: Digital Chat Station has shared details about the iPhone 18e before, and today the tipster is back on Weibo with a fuller picture of the iPhone 17e's successor. Apple launched the iPhone 17e in March, so a spring 2027 debut for the new model would fit the pattern, and the device has before been rumored to arrive alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2. According to DCS, the iPhone 18e will have a 6.12-inch LTPS OLED screen with a 60Hz refresh rate, so if you were hoping the "e" series would finally get a higher refresh rate, it looks like you'll have to keep waiting. title: Motorola Signature 27 and Razr Flex show up at a European retailer with prices
description: Motorola showed off the Signature 27 at Qualcomm's Snapdragon event last month, but it hasn't revealed the full specs or pricing yet. Now, Portuguese retailer MegaPC has listed the Motorola Signature 27, and reportedly the upcoming Motorola Razr Flex as well. The Signature 27 is listed in the Pantone Coal Smoke color with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for €1,594.90. The page is currently marked as temporarily out of stock, and there's no word on when it will ship. The description mostly repeats what Motorola has already said: the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, a 200MP...

title: WhatsApp is bringing its media hub to iPhones
description: Last year, WhatsApp introduced a media hub on Mac and the web, which displays photos, videos, links, and documents from all of your conversations in one place. Now, the feature is on its way to iOS too, as spotted by digging into the latest WhatsApp beta (version 26.42.10.74). The media hub will live in the app's settings, and it will only show media you've received - so anything you've sent won't be there, and neither will disappearing media. It will have two tabs, New for recently received items and All media for everything. You'll be able to filter by photos, videos, or links, switch...

title: Samsung's next foldable leaks in official-looking renders
description: A few days ago a leaked image gave us our first look at Samsung's next foldable smartphone, the W27. This will be launching in China on October 29, as the latest member of the W series. The W devices are basically fancier China-only versions of the company's latest Z series book-style foldable. So this year, the W27 will be a Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra in a dark blue trim with gold accents. title: vivo X500 Pro in for review
description: The vivo X500 series only just became global, and we've got the X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max in the office, alongside the X500, which is not coming to Europe for now. The series is oddly lopsided, with the Pro Max towering over the Pro with a 6.85-inch display, and the X500 sitting in the middle with a 6.59-inch screen. The X500 Pro is the most compact at 6.36 inches. The global vivo X500 series The global vivo X500 Pro ships without a charger - you get a case and a USB-A to USB-C cable. The 90W charger is seemingly reserved for the Pro Max model. Unboxing the vivo X500...

title: Apple updates 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac with the M6 processor
description: Apple has updated the base 14-inch MacBook Pro and the iMac models with its latest generation M6 processor. The MacBook Pro was previously running the M5 chip from 2025 while the iMac was last updated in 2024 with the M4. The base 14-inch MacBook Pro model with the M6 processor gets a 12-core CPU with the 2+4+6 layout as well as a 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core and hardware accelerated ray tracing support. There's also a separate dual 16-core Neural Engine. The base configuration includes 16GB unified memory that can be configured to 24GB or 32GB. Only the...

title: vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max go global
description: Last month, vivo launched its X500 series in China, leaving many to wonder when the series would make its way to global markets. Well, the brand did just that today with the global launch of the X500 series. It consists of all three previously launched phones with the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max all in tow. But as with past global rollouts from vivo, some regions like Europe won’t get the vanilla X500.
